item.text: Sicklethorn (*Asparagus falcatus*) is a large, thorny climber native to South Africa and Mozambique. It has curved dark-green leaves, fragrant white flowers, and red berries that attract birds. Fast-growing and tolerant of shade and some drought, it is often cultivated as a security hedge.
